news.headline: Maxey, Sixers turn Philly boos into cheers in 29-point comeback over Cavaliers
news.linkText: Maxey-led Sixers turn Philly boos into cheers in thrilling 29-point comeback
news.description: Booed after trailing by 24 at the half, the Sixers rode a game-high 32 points from Tyrese Maxey to erase a 29-point deficit and stun the Cavs 114-106 on Thursday.

images.name: Tyrese Maxey [600x400]
images.caption: Tyrese Maxey had a game-high 32 points to help the Sixers erase a 29-point deficit in the team's largest comeback in the play-by-play era.

rotowire.headline: Maxey finished Wednesday's 114-109 victory over the Pacers with 27 points (8-18 FG, 3-7 3Pt, 8-9 FT), five rebounds, four assists and one steal in 36 minutes.
rotowire.story: Maxey took over down the stretch, scoring 17 points in the fourth quarter and knocking down two three-pointers in the final 90 seconds to help Philadelphia secure the comeback victory. The dynamic guard led the 76ers in scoring and continued to shoulder a significant offensive workload despite sharing the floor with several established stars. His combination of scoring volume, perimeter shooting and heavy minutes makes him a dependable fantasy option.
rotowire.description: Maxey finished Wednesday's 114-109 victory over the Pacers with 27 points (8-18 FG, 3-7 3Pt, 8-9 FT), five rebounds, four assists and one steal in 36 minutes.

fantasy.projection: Maxey is coming off a campaign in which he averaged career highs in all six fantasy counting categories: points, assists, rebounds, steals, 3-pointers and blocks. He was fifth in fantasy points per game and fourth in total fantasy points and is still only 25 years old. The 76ers made big moves this offseason, bringing in both Jaylen Brown and LeBron James. While this increases the team's chances to contend, it likely puts a cap on Maxey's volume upside.
